title: HoneyBook bets on agentic AI to streamline small business operations with its new Claude connector
summary: HoneyBook has launched HoneyBook MCP, a connector that integrates its small business management platform with Anthropic's Claude AI assistant, enabling independent businesses to leverage autonomous AI agents for streamlined operations. This move aims to democratize enterprise-grade AI capabilities for small businesses and freelancers who previously lacked access to such technology.
problem_solved: Brings autonomous AI agent capabilities to small businesses and independent professionals who lack the resources of large enterprises.
why_valuable: Levels the playing field by giving small businesses access to the same AI-powered automation tools that large corporations use, improving operational efficiency.
